name: Nikolay Petrushev
strengths: Petrushev slides back in pass protection and uses that 6-6 reach so the rusher has to go the long way.
Petrushev locks on in the run game, drives the defensive tackle inside, then gets up and walls off the linebacker.
Petrushev has the length Trautwein can coach from a lower pad once he sits in his stance.
weaknesses: Petrushev plays too high and bends at the waist. Trautwein's first job is to sit him in his stance, bend the knees, and get that 6-6 length working from a lower pad.
comparison: Petrushev comps to Wyatt Milum — same 6-6 frame, long arms, still filling out toward starter weight.
projection: Petrushev should spend Year 1 getting bigger, then rotate in Year 2 and 3. Ceiling is a multi-year SEC starter if the weight comes and Trautwein gets him playing lower.
schemeFit: Petrushev fits as a tackle who wins with length first while Trautwein sits him in his stance and the weight catches up.
